verdict.rationale: Synctera explicitly provides a Sandbox environment with API keys, documented sandbox test cases for KYC/KYB flows, and auto-pass behaviors (e.g., KYB auto-approved in Sandbox), letting users exercise the API stack without touching production data. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity or data-isolation guarantees, and no explicit statement about data reset/isolation mechanics.
